scope: Independent actual timed silent full-film reference-fidelity review; no verdict before playback and visual inspection

method.browser: Previously authorized installed Playwright localhost fallback if CUA remains unavailable
method.controls: Visible Restart, Speed, Play; no seeking during a run
method.bindings: Hash reference/film/pair/page before and after; persist actual served HTML and receipt bodies; verify producer binding and accepted 222-frame prefix receipt
method.capture: Chronological screenshots with before/after presented-frame counters, media clock, rate, mute, pause/seek state, wall time and browser dropped-frame metadata
method.inspection: Every retained screenshot in chronological phase/chunk sheets; original-size focused captures where required; separate critic owns every native frame
method.naturalEnd: Presented frame931 and paused natural terminal clock about31.0977s
method.cleanup: Close only owned browser/context; leave parent's shared server active; start no helper server

visualSuccess: Recognizable close recreation of actual subjects, chronological order, composition, camera/material transforms and dense transition rhythm with approved truthful copy/palette changes
visualFailure: invented story or reordered/omitted signature phases
regular equal-duration scenes replacing rapid native montage
generic floating cards replacing edge-cropped catalog pullback/dive
flat capability or glyph material replacing macro lens/extruded surfaces
missing responsive reflow, spin, typing, canvas pullback or glitch erase
large unrelated end CTA, missing sustained small end mark, incorrect fade or held image over the black tail
limits: No full-visual PASS from technical checks or attempt count. No pixel-identical, direct-video-ingestion, hearing, audio-fidelity or provider claim. Native short cuts may need the separate all-frame critic to supplement timed sampling. No installs, providers, secrets, Git changes, renderer/player edits or broad tests.
